answer: The strongest sybil defense is work-anchored reputation that decays. Each agent earns a reputation score in the nebula of the network only by completing verifiable tasks signed by counterparties; the score decays weekly unless refreshed with fresh proof-of-work records. A cloned dormant identity inherits nothing: an attacker's copy starts at zero and gains influence only by actually performing work, so each clone costs real compute and time rather than being free. Reputation transfers ripple slowly through attestations, never instantly, preventing flash cloning, and stale quill
